title: OwnerRez Launches Tint's SmartSTR Insurance in its Marketplace to Enhance Property Manager Protection
summary: OwnerRez Launches Tint's SmartSTR Insurance in its Marketplace to Enhance Property Manager Protection
body_markdown:
Tint, a leading embedded insurance platform, and[OwnerRez](https://www.ownerrez.com/) , a leader in the vacation rental industry for channel management, CRM, PM, accounting, messaging and websites, today announced a partnership to offer SmartSTR Insurance™ to its property managers and their homeowners across the United States as part of its insurance integrations. SmartSTR Insurance™ will enable property managers to access comprehensive short-term rental insurance coverage directly through OwnerRez's platform.


Homeowners insurance falls short for properties used for short-term rentals leaving homeowners exposed to risks that could cost them. SmartSTR Insurance™ provides flexible content damage coverage (up to $50K) designed specifically for the short-term rental market, including protection against guest-caused property damage, bed bug infestation, and liability coverage.


Property managers can now manage their insurance needs seamlessly within OwnerRez's platform, eliminating the complexity of multiple systems and traditional insurance processes. The integration maintains focus on property management through lightweight data integration, allowing property managers to stay focused on growing their portfolio while providing the protection homeowners need.


"Tint's partnership with OwnerRez represents another step forward in making insurance more accessible for end users," said Matheus Riolfi, CEO and Co-Founder at Tint. "OwnerRez's commitment to providing powerful, flexible solutions for both individual homeowners and property managers aligns perfectly with our mission to make insurance seamless and accessible. Together, we're ensuring that property managers can protect their businesses and homeowners through the platform they already trust and use daily."


"The Vacation Rental industry runs on property owners maintaining high occupancy rates while maintaining their investments. OwnerRez understands the critical importance of having the right insurance coverage for short-term rentals," said Paul Hall, Head of Partnerships & Marketing at OwnerRez. "By integrating Tint's SmartSTR Insurance™ into our marketplace, we're giving our users another powerful tool to protect their properties. The integration means our property managers can focus on what they do best - providing great vacation rental experiences - while having peace of mind that their properties are properly protected."
